title: Structural Survey Summary: 18 Orchard Row
key_sentences: Thank you for instructing us to inspect the above property on 28 April 2026.
This letter summarises our main findings.
The full report is enclosed and should be read alongside this summary.
The house is in fair condition for its age, and we found no sign of serious structural movement.
The table lists each element that needs attention, with our suggested action and its priority.
The figures below are indicative only and exclude VAT.
They should be confirmed by written quotations from your chosen contractors.
We would be pleased to discuss any of these points with you.
Please telephone me on 01234 000111 if you would like to arrange a meeting.

list_items.text: 1. Arrange for the chimney stack to be repointed before the autumn.

'3.' with nested '(a)' '(b)'. Both tables are grids and neither is split across pages: the findings table (zebra fills) sits on page 1 and the costs table, which ends in a bold grey total row, sits whole at the top of page 2 after its heading and introduction on page 1.
